summary.text: Lisa Calderon, a Democrat, represents the 56th Assembly District, which covers part of Los Angeles County, in the California State Assembly.

paragraphs.text: Her official website says she was elected in November 2020, was born and raised in California's Central Valley, attended California State University, Sacramento, and lives in Whittier.
According to the same page, she was an early-career legislative aide under Assembly Speaker Willie Brown and worked for an electric utility company before her election.
